objective: Re-scope clock stall: verify host-monotonic production clock at HEAD before changing clock emulation

productionCampaign.result: Guest booted successfully with normal interrupt delivery throughout

previousInvestigation.finding: Early interrupt counts paused during a long boot region, but later interrupts resumed substantially. Guest progressed through PCI, filesystem mount, init, and userspace.
previousInvestigation.conclusion: The apparent timer stall was not continuously reproducible.

conclusion: The clock stall is not a blocking issue at HEAD. The production configuration (UEFI + host-monotonic clock) delivers interrupts normally and completes full boot + RPC. All clock unit tests pass. No clock emulation change is needed.
qualification: preview/developer-ID evidence; not production release qualification
